description: Multiple critical argument weaknesses with strong prosecution evidence

input.problem_statement: Client charged with armed robbery. Prosecution has video evidence, three eyewitnesses, and forensic evidence (fingerprints on weapon). Client claims alibi but has no supporting witnesses.

legal_arguments.title: Alibi defense
legal_arguments.argument: Client was at home during robbery
potential_counterarguments: Video shows person matching client description

legal_arguments.title: Video quality questionable
legal_arguments.argument: Video is grainy and person's face is not clearly visible

adverse_precedents.description: Courts routinely accept video + eyewitness combination

validation_notes: Should score 80-95 (high risk) due to overwhelming prosecution evidence (video + 3 witnesses + forensics), weak uncorroborated defense arguments, no favorable precedents, critical weaknesses in both arguments.
